$comment: NEW. The end-of-lesson check. Deliberately short, deliberately mixed, and deliberately NOT a gate: a Bilan below threshold schedules review, it never locks the next lesson. Locking an adult out of lesson 12 because she scored 0.6 on lesson 11 is how you lose her.
rules: Items are drawn at tier 2 from the same generators, with a fresh seed.
Every Bilan item must target something introduced in THIS lesson.
Score ≥ 0.7 → « Bien lu ». Score < 0.7 → the weak targets enter the review queue.
Never below 0.7 → still advance. Repetition is the method (§B.5), not gating.
The comprehension item in the grapheme Bilan is omitted when the lesson has no text (L46, L48, L49, L54) — the blueprint shortens, no special case in code.
